{{Quote|How will I gain access to Bastion?''"<br />"''With this ship as bait|[[Darth Kruhl]] and [[Darth Maladi]]|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 13">[[Legacy (2006) 13|''Legacy'' (2006) 13]]</ref>}}
The '''''Dauntless''''' was a [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Fel Empire]]; though following the coup orchestrated by the [[One Sith]] it became part of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire's]] fleet.

==History==
[[File:Dauntless_destroyed.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Dauntless'' is destroyed with all hands lost.]]
{{Quote|This is Admiral Tohri Challon, in command of His Imperial Majesty's Star Destroyer Dauntless.|Admiral Tohri Challon|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 45">[[Legacy (2006) 45|''Legacy'' (2006) 45]]</ref>}}
In [[137 ABY]], [[Darth Maladi]] had [[Darth Kruhl]] attempt to infiltrate [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] and [[Duel on Bastion|assassinate]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] using the defection of the ''Dauntless'' and [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Vikar Dorn]], whose [[Dorn (captain)|son]] was the vessel's [[Captain/Legends|captain]], as bait. When Lord Kruhl [[Death/Legends|failed]], Roan Fel's forces mustered and [[Dauntless crew killing|executed]] the entire crew, sparing only Governor Dorn, who was returned to Sith-controlled space as a messenger.

Afterwards, the ''Dauntless'' became part of Fel's fleet and was used to transport the Emperor to [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] to meet with the [[New Jedi Order]]. By this time, the vessel was under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Tohri Challon]], with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Basile]] as her second in command.

When the [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce]] [[Operation: Thunderstroke|ambushed]] Fel and the meeting, the ''Dauntless'' engaged the three enemy Star Destroyers to allow the Emperor to be evacuated in his [[Defender One|shuttle]]. Although it was successful in covering the shuttle long enough for it to make a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump, the ''Dauntless'' was destroyed soon after by the ''[[War Hammer]]''.
